description:
## Problem
- **Logger levels leak between tests.**
  - `create_server(log_level="ERROR")` sets the root logger to ERROR (`benchbox/mcp/server.py:108`; `basicConfig` at import, `:32`).
  - `TestSetupVerboseLogging::test_quiet_mode` and `test_verbosity_settings_quiet_override` (`tests/unit/cli/test_run_command_branches.py:456,495`) leave it at CRITICAL (`cli/verbose_logging.py:38-51`).
  - Later `caplog` tests then capture nothing. With `-n 0`, running test_run_phase_validation.py before `tests/unit/core/test_deployment_selection.py` gives 4 "warns once" failures (`assert 0 == 1`).
  - The MCP test `test_quiescence_attestation_is_retried_and_logged_when_the_store_fails` (`tests/unit/mcp/test_durable_jobs.py:1269`) fails the same way.
  - Under `-n 8`, 2 of 8 runs failed. A probe counted 3,201 tests running at CRITICAL and 180 at ERROR.
- **`make test-pytest` turns off session isolation.** Any `-m` expression that would select a `live_integration`-only test turns off session isolation for the whole run (`_benchbox_pytest_xdist_safety.py:105-114,119`). That includes `make test-pytest`, which uses `-m "not stress"` (`Makefile:85-87`).
  - `session_home()` then raises (`tests/utilities/session_isolation.py:103-106`), and `test_init_default_path` fails (`tests/unit/core/results/test_database.py:124-129`).
  - The rest of the unit suite runs against the real HOME and ~/.benchbox.

## Change
- Add an autouse fixture that snapshots and restores logging config around each test, and point `caplog` at the emitting logger.
- Stop `create_server` changing the root level and calling `basicConfig` at import.
- Keep isolation on unless the marker expression excludes every non-live test, and make `test_init_default_path` robust.
